{{Top|leg}}
A '''mini-proton torpedo''' was a miniature [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]], scaled down to fit into a [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] mounted on the wrist of the [[Zero-G Assault Stormtrooper Armor Mark I]].
